text.what: Pinot's other well-known child, banished from the Côte d'Or by ducal edict and sent south to granite, where it built Beaujolais.
text.story: *Tradition holds —* Philippe le Hardi ordered gamay out of the good slopes in 1395 and pinot noir back in. Whatever the duke's reasons, the split held: pinot took the limestone, gamay took the granite south of Mâcon.

kin.as: Same parentage story, opposite fate on the same hill.
The region that expelled it from the Côte d'Or and still grows it further south.
